[i][u][b]USO Purchase of East Holler Island from[nation]Yulandburg[/nation][/b][/u]

On 18 February 2027, the United States of Oceanic transaction with the government of Yulandburg, finalizing the full purchase of East Holler Island for $145.4 million USD. The agreement grants the USO complete sovereignty, including mineral rights, maritime jurisdiction, and long-term administrative authority over the island and its surrounding waters.

The deal followed six months of confidential negotiations, driven by Yulandburgs growing fiscal pressures and the United States of Oceanic strategic interest in expanding its presence across the Northern Sea Corridor. East Holler Island, once considered a peripheral outpost, has recently gained value due to newly identified offshore rare-metal deposits and its position along emerging shift trade routes.

For the United States of Oceanic, the annexation is a step in strengthening its regional supply chain security, naval logistics, and early warning maritime infrastructure. Military planners have already proposed the construction of a joint naval and air base, while civilian ministries are preparing to integrate the island into the United States of Oceanic provincial governance structure by late 2028.

Wit the deal of Yulandburg government. The territorial purchase of a total $145.4 million USD. The agreement transfers full sovereignty, mineral rights, and administrative control of East Holler Island to the USO with full annex control over the island.[/i]
